title: smilax herbacea var. peduncularis
intro: Smilax herbacea var. peduncularis, commonly known as wild sarsaparilla, is a perennial plant species in the Smilacaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of wild sarsaparilla include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of wild sarsaparilla include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic activities.
